The rest, I can confirm. I will be without internet for a week or so, but if I stumble into this error type again, I will post it.

Getting this as well on current 4.7dev, occurs mostly whenever I resize the Godot editor window, as well as when I resize the game window. As mentioned it only occurs when the Vulkan renderer is in use, meaning compatibility is fine. It also requires Wayland to be enabled for the Editor. Annoyingly, this fills up the debugger as well which muffles actually important warnings, as well as generally driving me insane. To hopefully narrow it down for whomever looks into this, version 4.7dev3 is the first "official" build where this bug is introduced, 4.7-dev1 and -dev2 are not affected. It can be _reasonably_ assumed that [around 4.7dev3 is a good point to start looking](https://godotengine.github.io/godot-interactive-changelog/#4.7-dev3) Additionally, for granularity, no-mono vs mono makes no difference. System Info: ` Godot v4.7.dev.mono (718a3ffd2) - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 25 Mar 2026 23:30:07 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 595.58.03) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.26 GiB memory ` Desktop is KDE Plasma 6.6.3 ``` E 0:00:30:045 _determine_swap_chain_format: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: false drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3451 @ _determine_swap_chain_format() E 0:00:30:045 swap_chain_resize: Surface did not return any valid formats. Method/function failed. Returning: ERR_CANT_CREATE drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3712 @ swap_chain_resize() ```

Update here, switched over to 4.7.dev3.official standard and still encountering the issue with the testproject I made, in addition to a new error. Both errors are at different line numbers from the past build I was using. The error at 3752 procs after err is defined on the prior line as: `err = device_functions.CreateSwapchainKHR(vk_device, &swap_create_info, VKC::get_allocation_callbacks(VK_OBJECT_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_KHR), &swap_chain->vk_swapchain);` The error at 3451 procs after err is defined on the prior line as: `functions.GetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(physical_device, surface->vk_surface, &format_count, formats.ptr());`

Ok, I did a bit of digging, and to the best of my ability I'm thinking it's a synchronization issue? I noticed when trying to use Mailbox VSYNC there was a warning it was unavailable, so I disabled vsync altogether and have not seen the errors since. Another fix I tried was running with --display-driver x11 which also prevents errors, though it would be preferable to be on wayland.

I'm not really the most savvy in this area, but I think it might be something to do with FIFO protocol? When launching using --display-driver wayland --single-window I saw FIFO mentioned in the initial output.

`Godot Engine v4.7.dev3.official.60fff00a6 - https://godotengine.org
WARNING: xdg-toplevel-icon protocol not found! Cannot set window icon.

     at: init (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:5201)

WARNING: FIFO protocol not found! Frame pacing will be degraded.

     at: init (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:5216)

WARNING: Failed to load cached shader, recompiling.

     at: _load_from_cache (drivers/gles3/shader_gles3.cpp:615)

OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 580.142 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
Editing project: /mnt/87127e09-4891-4196-9bcc-f2400492755b/Gamedevelopment/swapchain-error-testproj`

I'm using niri for my window manager which I do not believe has a FIFO protocol as of yet, so if my assumptions are correct that is the cause, and not something wholly solvable on the godot side? FIFO mentioned for @TheYellowArchitect but not sure what wm they are using. However, with @Cautami using KDE Plasma 6.6.3 I do believe FIFO *is* implemented for that environment, so I could be wrong and the cause could still be something else.

> FIFO mentioned for @TheYellowArchitect but not sure what wm they are using.

I use `dwm`, X11
